violations.why: ISR is unmasked between the two task reads and can write v_quiver, so the reads can see different values.
ISR can run before disable_isr at line 38, set v_amber=0 and v_willow, and the task then reaches line 50 and reads a changed value.
ISR was enabled at line 41 and can run after the read at 42, set v_amber=0 and v_willow, and the task then passes the check at 47 and reads v_willow at 50.
After enable_isr at line 41 the ISR can set v_amber=0 before the task reads it at line 47.
